> **Historical document.** Written for the original Base44 build. The platform is now Lovable Cloud (Supabase); the canonical schema is `supabase/migrations/` and the functions are under `supabase/functions/`. Entity and app names below refer to the Base44 layout.

# DIBS SPV Factory — Schema Gap Analysis & Migration Report

**Date:** 2026-08-10  
**Generated by:** Elara (DIBS SPV Factory Super Agent)  
**Reference:** `docs/conceptual-architecture.md` §3 Canonical Data Model

## Methodology

Compared every field in the canonical data model against the deployed entity schemas in the Elara app (own entities) and the Zevia app (cross-app deal entities). Updated all gap-closeable schemas in-place. Remaining gaps require cross-app updates or platform-level configuration.

## Gap Summary

| Canonical Model Section | Entity | Gaps Found | Action Taken |
|---|---|---|---|
| Master Series LLC | MasterEntity | 4 missing fields | ✅ Schema updated |
| SPV series | Zevia:Spv | 6 missing fields | ⚠️ Cross-app — needs Zevia update |
| Deal configuration | (new) | Entity didn't exist | ✅ DealConfiguration entity created |
| Investor onboarding | Zevia:Investor | 6 missing fields | ⚠️ Cross-app — needs Zevia update |
| Document and audit objects | DocumentSet | 3 missing fields | ✅ Schema updated |
| Audit event schema | SeriesRegistryLog | 3 missing fields | ✅ Schema updated |
| EIN request object | EINRequest | 4 missing fields | ✅ Schema updated |
| First-sale tracking | FormDFiling | 5 missing timestamps | ✅ Schema updated |
| Series isolation | (platform) | RLS not configured | ⚠️ Platform-level — needs Base44 RLS enablement |

## Detailed Gap Resolution

### 1. MasterEntity — ✅ Resolved

**Added fields:**
- `certificate_of_formation_hash` (string) — SHA-256 hash for integrity verification
- `liability_notice_verified_at` (date-time) — when notice was last verified
- `registered_agent_id` (string) — Delaware registered agent identifier
- `operating_agreement_version` (string) — current LLC agreement version

**Existing fields retained:** `legal_name`, `delaware_entity_id`, `formation_date`, `has_liability_notice`, `certificate_file_uri`, `amendment_count`, `last_amendment_date`, `status`

### 2. SeriesRegistryLog — ✅ Resolved

**Added fields:**
- `actor_role` (string) — role of the actor (sponsor, system, compliance_reviewer, counsel)
- `source_system` (string, default "elara") — source system that generated the event
- `correlation_id` (string) — correlates related events across the pipeline

**Added event types:**
- `INVESTOR_INVITED`, `SUBSCRIPTION_SENT`, `SUBSCRIPTION_EXECUTED`, `FIRST_SALE_RECORDED`, `AMENDMENT`, `WIND_DOWN`

**Mapping to canonical audit event schema:**
| Canonical field | Deployed field | Status |
|---|---|---|
| `event_id` | `id` (auto) | ✅ |
| `event_type` | `event_type` | ✅ |
| `series_id` | `series_id` / `spv_id` | ✅ |
| `actor_id` | `actor` | ✅ |
| `actor_role` | `actor_role` | ✅ Added |
| `occurred_at` | `timestamp` | ✅ |
| `source_system` | `source_system` | ✅ Added |
| `payload_hash` | `hash` | ✅ |
| `previous_event_hash` | `previous_hash` | ✅ |
| `correlation_id` | `correlation_id` | ✅ Added |
| `organization_id` | (platform `created_by`) | ✅ Platform-handled |

### 3. EINRequest — ✅ Resolved

**Added fields:**
- `ss4_payload_version` (string) — version of the SS-4 data packet
- `submission_channel` (enum: ONLINE, PHONE, FAX, MAIL) — IRS submission method
- `submission_at` (date-time) — when submitted to the IRS
- `exception_code` (enum) — specific exception type for FAILED/THROTTLED status

### 4. DocumentSet — ✅ Resolved

**Added fields:**
- `template_id` (string) — reference to template registry
- `formation_event_id` (string) — reference to SeriesRegistryLog entry
- `external_reference` (string) — external system reference (e-signature, filing system)

**Added document types:**
- `INVESTOR_QUESTIONNAIRE`, `ACCREDITATION_PACKAGE`, `RISK_DISCLOSURE`, `FEE_WATERFALL_SCHEDULE`, `CAPITAL_CALL_NOTICE`, `SIGNATURE_PACKET`, `COMPLIANCE_FILING`

**Added status:**
- `BLOCKED` — for documents that cannot be generated due to template/legal issues

### 5. FormDFiling — ✅ Resolved

**Added first-sale tracking timestamps:**
- `soft_circle_at` — soft circle timestamp (NOT a first sale)
- `subscription_sent_at` — when subscription docs were sent
- `subscription_signed_at` — when first subscription was signed
- `irrevocable_commitment_at` — first irrevocable contractual commitment (starts 15-day clock)
- `funds_received_at` — when funds were received
- `funds_cleared_at` — when funds cleared

### 6. DealConfiguration — ✅ New Entity Created

Fields: `spv_id`, `deal_id`, `sponsor_id`, `asset_type`, `asset_location`, `purchase_price`, `target_raise`, `minimum_raise`, `maximum_raise`, `offering_exemption`, `investor_type`, `fee_schedule`, `waterfall_configuration`, `closing_conditions`, `structure_type`, `series_type`, `close_target_date`, `status`

### 7. Cross-App Gaps (Zevia App) — ⚠️ Pending

**Spv entity — missing fields:**
- `master_llc_id` — link to master entity
- `asset_strategy` — investment strategy description
- `banking_status` — bank readiness status
- `document_set_version` — current document set version
- `ledger_scope` — accounting ledger scope identifier
- `close_target_date` — target closing date

**Investor entity — missing fields:**
- `investor_entity_id` — for entity/trust investors
- `beneficial_owner_id` — UBO reference
- `aml_status` — separate from KYC status
- `signing_authority_status` — signatory verification
- `subscription_status` — subscription workflow state
- `funding_status` — funding workflow state
- `consent_status` — disclosure acknowledgment

### 8. Platform-Level Gaps — ⚠️ Pending

- **Row-level security (RLS)** — needs enablement on all entities with `series_id` or `spv_id` fields
- **Organization-level tenancy** — `organization_id` handled by Base44 platform's `created_by` field

## Phase 2 Prerequisites Met

The following schema updates enable Phase 2 (Investor Experience Layer):
- ✅ First-sale tracking timestamps on FormDFiling (for Form D clock)
- ✅ Document types expanded (investor questionnaire, accreditation, risk disclosure)
- ✅ Audit event types expanded (INVESTOR_INVITED, SUBSCRIPTION_SENT, SUBSCRIPTION_EXECUTED)
- ✅ DealConfiguration entity for offering exemption and investor type configuration
- ⚠️ Investor entity updates in Zevia (needed for KYC/AML orchestration)
